name: Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR Concept
description:
The Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR is a sports car and race car that was built by Mercedes-AMG, the performance and motorsport division of Mercedes-Benz. Intended for racing in the new FIA GT Championship series in 1997, the CLK GTR was designed primarily as a race car, with the road cars built to homologate the car for racing. Thus, it is considered a homologation special.

The CLK GTR is one of Mercedes-Benz's rarest cars, with only 25 road versions built in total. The race version used a 6.0L V12 engine producing over 600 hp with twin turbochargers.
author: Francisco Bort
